description: Designs a run: from a target end state to the loads of each segment that reach it, computed by the engine with no randomness, so the same request gives the same bits. request is a run_trajectory request; its numbers at the places vary names are the start, and vary gives each load's span inside the card's bounds. target is a number of the final state, a value and a tolerance. Every candidate is an ordinary run with its run_seal; one that crosses a limit is recorded refused by its name, and no value is moved back. The answer gives the timeline, its run_trajectory request and run_seal, the value reached and the miss, every candidate in order as a run_dataset plan with its dataset_seal, and a design_seal. Outcome reached; not_reached, meaning this search found none inside its caps, which is not a limit of the physics; or refused: TargetOutsideCard for a target outside the card's range, TargetBeyondReach where the card's map is monotone and a corner of the loads allowed falls short. The search is coordinate bisection, capped at 64 candidates (DESIGN_MAX_CANDIDATES), 1000000 steps (DESIGN_MAX_STEPS) and 10000 recorded frames (DESIGN_MAX_FRAMES) in all, and 4 sweeps (DESIGN_MAX_SWEEPS). verify_tape, given this whole answer as it came, designs it again and compares the two, byte for byte (the long form). On this open connection a design is long work whenever its candidates may take more than 10000 steps together. One address holds at most 1 physics permit at a time, and long work (a solve, a plan of runs or of solves, a run of more than 10000 steps, or a verification that computes one again) runs 1 at a time. A call that finds no permit or no place is answered "Too many concurrent physics tasks." and nothing waits: the same call sent later is answered once one is free. An answer is waited for 60 seconds, and long work is stopped there.

request.description: A run_trajectory request as that tool takes it, with no from or readout, and a number at every place vary names: the search's start. Nothing is filled in.

target.description: The end state to reach: the quantity of the run's final state within value plus or minus tolerance, after its last step, or, for a run that ends at an end its card declares (a reactor past its first maximum of power), where the event finished. A run refused part way gives no value. A target outside the range the card declares for that quantity is refused before any run (TargetOutsideCard).

quantity.description: A number the card publishes in the final state, such as temperature_k.

tolerance.description: How near is reached: the final value within value plus or minus tolerance. Above zero.

value.description: The value the run's final state is to reach.

vary.description: From 1 to 8 loads the search sets, in the order a sweep takes them. The search sets loads only, never a start value, the step or the steps, and each load is held constant through its segment. low and high are the span the actuator allows; each lies at or inside the card's declared bound of the load, and a load the card bounds by nothing of its own (the cold plate's heat_power_w) is bounded by this span alone.

low.description: The low end of the span the actuator allows, at or inside the card's declared bound of the load.

place.description: segments[<i>].load.<name> for one segment's load, or segments[*].load.<name> for one value held through every segment. The load is one number of the card.

name: design_run
